name: Cataby Backpack Lifeforce Edition
description: The Cataby is a stylish backpack built by Hardin Tactical to withstand rigorous adventures. The unique rectangle shape features a hard frame fitted around a durable and expandable softshell with two zippered pockets allowing for easy access to essentials. The MPUV-1C Edition also comes with a commemorative patch to celebrate the Argo Cargo's 2951 Best in Show victory.
